name: Technology assessment
problem: Weighing a new technology means holding options, actors and consequences side by side. A designer made for (constructive) technology assessment lays them out so trade-offs can be seen and argued over, not buried in a document.

name: Humans and agents together
problem: When people and software agents work on the same task, each needs to see what the other is doing and why. A shared, specialized view gives both the same picture of the work and its state.

name: Clarity in textual data
problem: Structure hidden in logs, notes and plain-text formats is hard to see line by line. A designer tuned to one format shows that structure directly, while the text stays the source of truth.
